name: CMAS
description:
CMAS, the odd one out of them all. It's got the low level speed and is light on resources, while being a marked step up from prior implementations.
Unfortunately, CMAS suffers from several flaws that make it less... apealling, compared to its contemporaries. It is, for one, quite unstable & quite fragile. It is frequently prone to crashes, and when it does, it done takes yo ram with it 😔
However, the silver lining is that CMAS runs blazingly fast and is incredibly lightweight, being able to even run on MS-DOS when compiled with an appropriate compiler.
